components.name: Screen
components.description: ScreenSchema root container. Not a standalone registry export — renderer maps to Stack with flex 1 and screen padding.

props.name: padding
props.description: Screen edge padding applied by renderer
props.aiHint: Use token-aligned padding presets, not raw pixel values

props.name: spacing
props.description: Default gap between direct children when renderer wraps in Stack

avoid: Do not pass arbitrary style objects from ScreenSchema
Do not nest Screen inside Screen

components.name: Stack
components.description: Flex layout primitive with token-based spacing via gap.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Gap between children (token preset or number in TSX)

avoid: Do not use gap prop — Stack uses spacing
Do not inline magic margin on children

components.name: View
components.description: Plain react-native View — generic container when no higher-level primitive fits.
avoid: Prefer Stack for spacing — View has no gap
Do not use style for colors — use kit components

components.name: Grid
components.description: Wrap-based responsive grid. Children default to one track; use GridItem for spans.

props.name: columns
props.description: Track count — each cell is span/columns wide

components.name: GridItem
components.description: Grid cell that spans multiple tracks.

props.name: offset
props.description: Tracks to skip before this cell

avoid: Must be placed inside a Grid

components.name: Card
components.description: Elevated surface for grouped content; pairs with CardHeader/CardTitle/CardContent/CardFooter in TSX.
avoid: Do not pass style for elevation — card styling is baked in

components.name: Paper
components.description: Surface with flat/elevated/outlined variants.
avoid: Do not pass raw style for shadow

components.name: Separator
components.description: Hairline horizontal or vertical separator.
avoid: Do not use Separator as a spacer — use Stack spacing

components.name: Text
components.description: Typography primitive with shadcn-style variants (h1–h4, p, lead, muted, …).

children.description: Use children string prop or text child in schema

avoid: Do not wrap plain strings in View
Do not use random fontSize

components.name: Link
components.description: Inline text link; presses href through scheme-guarded Linking.

components.name: Button
components.description: Primary action control with shadcn variants and sizes.

props.name: action
props.aiHint: Do not embed onPress functions in JSON

avoid: Do not pass arbitrary onPress from schema JSON
Do not use raw style for colors — use variant

components.name: Input
components.description: Bare text input (TextInput wrapper). Use TextField for label/error/helper chrome.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value or binding key in schema

avoid: Do not pass style prop
Use TextField when you need a label or error message

components.name: TextField
components.description: Input with label, required marker, description, and error message.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; marks the input invalid

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Boolean checkbox control (unlabeled — compose with Stack + Text for labels).

examples.name: Terms acceptance
examples.tsx:
<Stack direction="row" spacing="sm" alignItems="center">
  <Checkbox />
  <Text>I agree to the terms</Text>
</Stack>

avoid: Do not pass onCheckedChange functions in schema JSON

components.name: Switch
components.description: On/off toggle control (unlabeled — compose with Stack + Text for labels).

examples.name: Notifications toggle
examples.tsx:
<Stack direction="row" spacing="sm" alignItems="center" justifyContent="space-between">
  <Text>Enable notifications</Text>
  <Switch checked />
</Stack>

avoid: Do not pass onCheckedChange in schema JSON

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact status label.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Compact interactive tag with remove affordance.
avoid: Do not use onClick/onRemove in JSON — use action

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline contextual feedback banner.

children.description: Use children string prop; compose AlertTitle/AlertDescription nodes for richer content

avoid: Do not use Alert for blocking confirmations — use AlertDialog

components.name: AlertTitle
components.description: Bold title line inside Alert.
avoid: Must be placed inside an Alert

components.name: AlertDescription
components.description: Muted body text inside Alert.
avoid: Must be placed inside an Alert

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Avatar container — compose AvatarImage + AvatarFallback inside.

components.name: AvatarImage
components.description: Image layer inside Avatar.

props.name: source
props.description: RN Image source — always the literal shape { uri: "https://…" }

avoid: Must be placed inside an Avatar

components.name: AvatarFallback
components.description: Fallback content (initials) shown while avatar loads/fails.
avoid: Must be placed inside an Avatar

components.name: Icon
components.description: Lucide icon rendered by name from the kit ICON_MAP.

props.name: name
props.description: Icon name from the kit ICON_MAP (e.g. search, settings)

components.name: Image
components.description: RN Image with rounded corners, aspect ratio, and loading placeholder.

props.name: source
props.description: RN Image source — always the literal shape { uri: "https://…" }

components.name: Progress
components.description: Determinate progress bar (0–100).

components.name: List
components.description: Sectioned list container; renders children or a FlatList for data+renderItem (not schema-expressible).

components.name: ListItem
components.description: Pressable list row with title, subtitle, and chevron.

examples.name: Pressable row
examples.tsx: <ListItem title="Account" subtitle="Profile and security" chevron onPress={handleOpenAccount} />

avoid: Do not pass onPress in schema JSON — use action

components.name: Modal
components.description: Native modal overlay with compound header/content/footer.
components.supportReason: Depends on native Modal, AnimatedOverlay, and safe-area behavior
avoid: Not available in web preview MVP

support.reason: Depends on native Modal, AnimatedOverlay, and safe-area behavior

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Decision surface with title, content, and actions.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: Critical confirmation dialog.
components.supportReason: Built on Dialog native overlay stack

support.reason: Built on Dialog native overlay stack

components.name: Sheet
components.description: Gesture-driven bottom sheet with snap points.
components.supportReason: Requires Reanimated gestures and native sheet physics

support.reason: Requires Reanimated gestures and native sheet physics

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Native date/time picker.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Side drawer panel with gesture dismiss.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Anchored floating content.
components.supportReason: Measure/layout anchoring differs on web vs native

support.reason: Measure/layout anchoring differs on web vs native

components.name: Popper
components.description: Positioned overlay relative to anchor.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.description: Long-press context menu.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: Anchored dropdown menu with trigger/content/item compound API.
components.supportReason: Anchored overlay positioning and trigger measurement

support.reason: Anchored overlay positioning and trigger measurement

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Swipeable carousel with pagination.

components.name: AnimatedOverlay
components.description: Animated backdrop wrapper for overlays.
components.supportReason: Reanimated enter/exit and native modal host

support.reason: Reanimated enter/exit and native modal host

components.name: AnimatedList
components.description: List with layout animations.
components.supportReason: Reanimated layout animations and list virtualization

support.reason: Reanimated layout animations and list virtualization

components.name: Toast
components.description: Transient toast notification host.
components.supportReason: Portal positioning and native toast host

support.reason: Portal positioning and native toast host

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: Bottom snackbar message.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tabbed navigation with animated indicator.
components.supportReason: Reanimated indicator and gesture-heavy tab bar

support.reason: Reanimated indicator and gesture-heavy tab bar

components.name: Select
components.description: Dropdown select with sheet/modal presentation.
components.supportReason: Native sheet/modal picker and gesture interactions

support.reason: Native sheet/modal picker and gesture interactions
